$comment: WORKER-1 NATIVE GUARD REGISTRATION — AR-1266 §F, on AR-1265 §5.5/§5.6.
SessionStart verifies the resume anchor (branch + head + the AR-1265 §4 hash-pinned dirty
exception) and is what sets TF_CLAUDE_GUARD_ANCHOR_OK. PreToolUse is fail-closed without it.
THE MATCHER INCLUDES Agent|Task DELIBERATELY (AR-1265 §3.1). At the graded pin it read
'Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|Bash' while the G2 pre-call guard watched {Agent, Task} — a correct
guard that could never receive the event it exists to stop. MEASURED on this runtime: the
subagent dispatch tool is named 'Agent'; no 'Task' tool is present in its registry. Both are
registered because an absent name costs nothing and an unguarded one is the one-shot hole.
TaskCompleted IS DELIBERATELY NOT REGISTERED. The pinned bridge fail-closes TaskCompleted to
'block' whenever manifest.finish.enabled !== true, and finish is correctly disabled (no
finished packet exists to check yet). Registering it now would block every task completion in
this seat. AR-1265 §5.7 holds full 'P1 NATIVE ACTIVE' back for exactly this reason.
The command is a DOORWAY, not a second guard: scripts/claude_guard_hook.mjs materializes the
pinned toolbox and executes the pinned claude-hook-runner.mjs. The law lives at the pin.
